name: std::basic_ofstream<CharT,Traits>::close
intro:
Closes the associated file.

Effectively calls rdbuf()->close(). If an error occurs during operation, setstate(failbit) is called.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is called by the destructor of basic_ofstream when the stream object goes out of scope and is not usually invoked directly.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Write and read a temporary file, then remove it. Public streambuf operations dispatch to filebuf's protected overflow, uflow, pbackfail, imbue, and sync functions.
